children: Iridium Communications filed a definitive proxy and set a Sept. 24, 2026 special meeting to vote on the Rocket Lab merger.
Definitive proxy filed Aug. 26, 2026 for special meeting on Sept. 24, 2026; record date Aug. 21, 2026 for voting eligibility.
Mergers: Merger Sub I to merge into Iridium, then surviving entity to merge into Merger Sub II, subject to closing conditions.
Iridium expects to complete the Mergers in mid-2027, subject to stockholder approval and other closing conditions.
Three shareholder lawsuits and additional demand letters allege disclosure deficiencies; company denies merit but will supplement proxy to avoid delay.
